title: Choose the visual world for Prior Auth Express
question: The roll assigned the Coverage Register. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Coverage Register
options.lineage: eCFR, the Federal Register, and the CMS coverage documents nurses read every day
options.thesis: A determination is a citable instrument: each criterion is a numbered policy clause, and each fact is a pinpoint citation into the record.
options.viewport: A case opens as a preamble (MEMBER, SERVICE, POLICY, ACTION), then the policy clauses beside the record, with each quote highlighted where it lives.
options.risk: Legal grammar can feel bureaucratic when it is overdone. The Federal Register serif would pull it toward the editorial cliché, so the whole world stays in one government sans.

raised.raise: Running time: every docket row and case header ends in its remaining SLA time, set tight to the right margin, so the queue reads as a budget.
Fixed stations: the case lifecycle is a fixed rail (queued, analyzing, recommended, decided, letter ready). State lights a station; nothing moves or reflows.
Designed absence: a criterion with no supporting quote gets a ruled, empty citation slot that reads 'No supporting text in the record', drawn as carefully as a found quote.
Read and write in one place: the letter is edited where it is read. Marking it ready removes edit mode, and the lock shows on the page itself.
Achromatic text: all reading text stays in ink. Color lives only in small state marks and the evidence highlight, never in tinted panels.
Linked selection: one click on a criterion lights its quote in the record and its line in the draft letter at the same time.

options.label: Clinical Flowsheet
options.lineage: nursing flowsheets, MAR grids, and the hand-ruled shift report sheet
options.thesis: The case is a flowsheet: criteria run down the rows, record documents run across the columns, and each cell holds the charted evidence.
options.viewport: The patient banner across the top, then a dense criteria-by-document grid where found evidence fills cells and gaps stay flagged.
options.risk: It is familiar: this is how most clinical software already looks, so it can read as one more EHR screen.

options.label: Cassette J-Card
options.thesis: The queue as side A and side B, each case timed to fit the tape.
options.viewport: A folded inlay with cases listed as tracks and running times at the margin.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nurses do not see their work in a mixtape, and handwriting erodes trust in a signed decision.
options.kept: The time budget is the composition: remaining SLA time sits right-aligned on every row.
options.risk: Nostalgic and informal for a regulated decision.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Each case travels a line from intake to letter, with the nurse and the engine as interchanging routes.
options.viewport: A lifecycle line map, with each case as a station on its route.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it clarifies the lifecycle but not the criterion-by-evidence work, and a dark ground fights a bright office.
options.kept: Fixed stations: lifecycle positions never move; only their state changes.
options.risk: Decorative when there is only one route per case.

options.label: Seven-Segment Display
options.thesis: The SLA clock as lit segments, with unlit cells designed too.
options.viewport: Countdown digits dominate each case over a black ground.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it serves one element, and a red-on-black world reads as alarm in a queue that must stay calm.
options.kept: Designed absence: a missing quote is drawn as a deliberate empty slot.
options.risk: Constant urgency; tiring over a shift.

options.label: HyperCard Stack
options.thesis: Each case is a card; reading and editing are two modes of one object.
options.viewport: A single black-and-white case card with painted buttons.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nurses have no tie to HyperCard, and one-bit grays cannot carry clinical state.
options.kept: Read and write in one place: the letter is edited where it is read.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.thesis: An achromatic field where color appears only at the edge of meaning.
options.viewport: Quiet white panels, with pastel bands marking evidence confidence.
options.case: Fuses poorly: pastels read as soft uncertainty where the decision needs firm states.
options.kept: Achromatic text: color never tints reading surfaces.

options.label: Miura-Fold Sheet
options.thesis: A compact case packet unfolds into the full review sheet in one pull.
options.viewport: Worklist rows as folded packets that deploy into the case.
options.case: Fuses poorly: folding metaphors add motion but no clinical meaning.
options.kept: Linked selection: one action propagates across criterion, record, and letter.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Modern clinical SaaS, executed impeccably: sidebar, cards, pills, and a blue primary.
canonCard.viewport: A left sidebar, KPI tiles over the worklist, and case details in tabbed cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every utilization management vendor, by design.
